item.title: LOT-097: ADR 0014 — BBCode preview renderer: HFR's own rendering model in HFRParsing, output through the LOT-034 normalizer
item.body:
LOT-097
Refs #189 (phase 1: the ADR and the spec; the renderer is #444, stacked on this one, `Closes #189`)
Refs #157 (FEAT-013, proposed by Bybifok)
Claim: cloud/lot-097

**Problem.** FEAT-013 asks for a preview of a draft "exactly as HFR will render it". The legacy app has no preview; the issue leaves the module (HFRParsing or app), the input/output, the fidelity rule and the security model to an ADR, to be merged before any code.

**Decision (ADR 0014).** A local, pure `BBCodeRenderer` in `HFRParsing` that follows **HFR's own rendering model**: the text is rewritten tag by tag into the HTML string HFR writes (one shape per tag, each proven by a captured pair; crossed tags come out crossed, as HFR writes them), and that string is parsed **on the reader's own path, twice as the reader does** (inside the thread page's markup, serialized back as `MessageBlockParser.contentHTML`, then `MessageContentNormalizer`, the sanitizer of record), so the preview gets the same tree-builder repairs, the same sanitizer and the same display stack as the posted message (`TopicHTMLBuilder`, `ReaderWebController`: `hfrreader:` scheme, CSP `script-src 'none'`, images through the cookie-less client and policy C). Everything no pair proves is text, as HFR does with `[color=]`, `[list]` and an unclosed tag. Fidelity is measured by differential tests against HFR's own rendering on five pairs: run 9's `/apercu.php` (`W61`/`R95d`, `W62`/`R95h`) and the quote prefills of the LOT-001 corpus against the thread page (`R41a`/`R42`/`R41b` → `R20`), which settle smileys, the toolbar's colour syntax `[#RRGGBB]`, crossed tags and one whitespace rule.

**Operator choice O-1** (in the ADR with what each option shows otherwise than HFR, recorded on #189): FEAT-013 says "exact" and no local renderer is exact by construction. (a) local renderer labelled as a preview (recommended now), (b) local renderer plus an on-demand "aperçu HFR" calling `/apercu.php` (a later `HFRClient` lot; recommended if users report differences), (c) `/apercu.php` only. **Decided 2026-11-02: (b)** (#189); the `/apercu.php` flow is LOT-184 (#449, M5), opened by this PR.

**What changed.** `docs/adr/0014-bbcode-preview-renderer.md` (new) and its README row; `docs/lots/LOT-097-bbcode-preview-renderer.md` (new: API, the writer's passes, rendering table and whitespace table with one capture per row, differential-test design with every reduction counted, defaults for every uncaptured case, pending-capture list = #443, intentional differences); `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §6c `### LOT-097`; `docs/FEATURES.md` FEAT-013 row; one line of `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. No `LOTS.md` change. Issues opened: #443 (captures, `host: mac`), #445 (the normalizer's superlinear time on repeated crossed tags, found by the code review).

**What is not rendered identically** (acceptance criterion 1): the spec's Pending capture list, mirrored in #443: `[email]`, named colours, multi-line bullets, `[cpp]`/`[code]` syntax colours, `[quotemsg]`, nesting of one tag in itself and of blocks in inline tags, non-http(s) and bare URLs, smiley codes glued to words or inside URLs, tag case, tabs, HFR's limits, the preview → thread identity for smileys.

**Review.** Nine adversarial rounds by Opus (given the ADR, the spec and LESSONS, never the author's conclusions), each verifying the HFR facts against the capture bytes and measuring the claims: rounds 1 to 8 REQUEST CHANGES (72 findings in all, every one fixed or answered in a commit), **round 9 APPROVE on `86bf99a`** (three non-blocking nits, folded into #444's tests); two re-checks after it, each APPROVE on the new head: `1eb50fa` (the nested-block cost named in §4, found by #444's code review) and `3611bff` + `7a93c86` (CodeRabbit's four findings: the output contract, the O-1 conditional, the AGENTS.md citation, the protocol entry). APPROVE on `7a93c86`; then the operator decision **O-1 = (b)** (2026-11-02, #189) recorded in the ADR (status Accepted), the spec and FEAT-013, with the new lot **LOT-184** (#449, the on-demand `/apercu.php` flow in `HFRClient`, M5: row, spec stub, `lots.json`), re-checked twice (`a4a229d` REQUEST CHANGES, six doc findings fixed) APPROVE on `d92459e`; CodeRabbit's three findings on it (pre-decision wording, FEAT-013 lots, the LOT-184 transport sentence) fixed in `30f1696`, **APPROVE on head `30f1696`.**

**Checks.** `markdownlint-cli2` 0 errors, `scripts/check-lot-deps.py` 163 lots, 0 violations. No code in this PR.

**Merge.** An ADR: merged by `cloud/orch` or the maintainer (AGENTS.md §8).
